in_sanskrit.name: युगेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of the age or era
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: युः (yuḥ) - age or era, गे (ge) - lord, श (ś) - God. Thus, the name Yugesh means 'God of the age or era'.

in_hindi.name: युगेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: युग (yug) - age or era, ईश (īś) - God. Thus, the name Yugesh means 'God of the age or era' in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: யுகேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: யுகம் (yugam) - age or era, எஷ் (eś) - God. Thus, the name Yugesh means 'God of the age or era' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: యుగేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: యూగమ్ (yūgam) - age or era, ఎశ్ (eś) - God. Thus, the name Yugesh means 'God of the age or era' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Yugesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Progressive, New Age

in_bengali.name: Yugesh

data.cultural_impact: The name "Yugesh" signifies the one who brings a new age or ushers in a new era. This is a significant cultural implication as it reflects the Hindu belief in cycles of time and the importance of change and transformation. Furthermore, it underscores the role of individuals in shaping the course of history and the potential they have to make a positive impact on society. In Indian culture, names have deep roots and are often reflective of the values and aspirations of the family and community. The name "Yugesh" is a powerful reminder of the influence each person can have on the world and the responsibility to make the world a better place.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Yugesh" symbolizes the potential for personal growth and transformation. It is a call to embrace the new and to embody the qualities of renewal, rebirth, and enlightenment. In Hinduism, the concept of yuga refers to the current age or era, with each yuga marked by distinct spiritual qualities. The name "Yugesh" serves as a reminder of the individual's role in the collective spiritual evolution of humanity. It encourages one to strive for self-improvement, to cultivate inner peace, and to seek enlightenment in order to contribute positively to the world. The name "Yugesh" is a source of inspiration and motivation for those who bear it, reminding them of their innate potential to bring about positive change, both within themselves and in the world around them.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Yugesh' is said to have been derived from the Sanskrit words 'Yuga' meaning age or era and 'Ish' meaning god or ruler.
historical_references.context: It is believed that the name 'Yugesh' was given to individuals who were considered to be divine rulers or leaders during a particular age or era.

historical_references.reference: Another belief is that 'Yugesh' was the name of a legendary king who ruled during the Treta Yuga, one of the four ages in Hindu mythology.
historical_references.context: According to Hindu mythology, the Treta Yuga was an age of moral virtue and righteousness, and 'Yugesh' is said to have been an exemplary ruler during this time.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Yugesh continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
